text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After spending a day out with Taiki Shuttle, I take a breather in my office.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Let's go home together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're not done hangin' out till I'm back at my dorm! There's still more fun to be had!
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I need to work after this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh… I guess that comes first.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Aww…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've got it! I'll just wait till you're done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You go ahead and work as much as ya like!
choice_data_list: Are you sure? It might take until evening.
Are you sure? It might take until evening.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's no problem at all! I'll be real quiet, so as not to disturb ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's completely dark outside by the time I wrap up the last of my work.
choice_data_list: All done. Sorry to make you wait so long.
All done. Sorry to make you wait so long.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Zzz…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mornin', Trainer! See, you could barely tell I was here!
choice_data_list: Sorry there wasn't much for you to do.
Sorry there wasn't much for you to do.
You've got a bit of drool there.
You've got a bit of drool there.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mornin', Trainer! See, you could barely tell I was here!
choice_data_list: Sorry there wasn't much for you to do.
Sorry there wasn't much for you to do.
You've got a bit of drool there.
You've got a bit of drool there.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What're ya talkin' about? Watchin' ya work was plenty fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Though I did take a moment to rest my eyeballs! Hahaha!
choice_data_list: I'll walk you back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, Trainer! That ain't no way to speak to a lady!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But I tell ya what. Walk me back to my dorm, and I'll let ya off. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe, all right! Thanks a ton, my dear trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This can be my reward for keepin' ya company. Heck, I can wait all day if this kinda happiness is at the end of the road. ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna walk real slow, so let's chat it up like there's no tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle chatters happily with me all the way back, her face beaming with joy.
